findings.evidence: ai-kit keeps its settings in config.toml, one file per layer, then restates that the reader merges per key and a missing file is the empty state.
findings.fix: Move the layer-merge primer to a short pointer and keep only the non-obvious rules (local-only shadowing, command-bearing trust, migration-held). Record the cut.

findings.evidence: Workflow is a Process pattern, but Step 2.1's replacement gate and Step 2.2's propose-lanes order both restate rules that wizard-flow.md and catalog.md already own.
findings.fix: Keep one decision in each reference and leave SKILL.md as the route plus the gate that only it can enforce.

findings.evidence: NEVER and Gotchas name real landmines, but several NEVER lines repeat a later step instead of adding a reason the step lacks.
findings.fix: Keep the hard-won items (unknown host annotation, trust-local, data-use, auth.json) and fold the rest into the step that already states them.

findings.evidence: Step 1.5 says Run the catalog flow and MANDATORY read references/catalog.md, so the whole catalog file loads on every setup, not only when a pending old roster or a listing-less runtime needs it.
findings.fix: Gate catalog.md: read Pending old roster only when an old review-spec.toml is pending, and the rest only when a preferred runtime has no models list.

findings.evidence: Item 1 re-runs cache-path --kind catalog and retells the catalog build that catalog.md and Step 1.5 already resolved.
findings.fix: Start item 1 at the extra-candidate rule and point back to the catalog path already printed.

findings.evidence: The availability probe is an inline python3 -c that imports private helpers (_probe_lanes, _route_reviewers, cfg_resolve). A rename in the sibling module breaks the check with no factory subcommand to call.
findings.fix: Add one read-only subcommand on ai-kit-spec.py that prints the probe-key JSON, and call that instead of the snippet.

findings.evidence: Twenty-one cases have realistic prompts and verifiable assertions, but expected_output is prose an agent grades, and several prompts encode the answer (skip skill sorting, vendor of fake/* is fake, mode single).
findings.fix: Add one assertion per case that a script can check against the written TOML or the command log, and keep the scripted answers only in the edge cases that need them.

findings.evidence: Twenty queries, 11 should-trigger and 9 should-not, with near-misses, but no train/validation split.
findings.fix: Mark about 60% as train and hold the rest out, including at least three of the near-miss negatives.

findings.evidence: Today only Claude Code selects a model per call (its sonnet, opus, haiku and fable aliases) states a vendor model list with no source URL or date checked.
findings.fix: Read the host's current alias list with its --help or docs URL before asking, and record the date; offer only the aliases that command still prints.

findings.evidence: The design record in the ai-kit repository (docs/config/design.md) lists each one with its reason points at a path that is not in this tree.
findings.fix: Point at the file that exists, or drop the sentence and name the kept-apart files inline.
